about: the sheet is empty, so the values API returns no values

connector.none: the captured Google Drive connector reads a spreadsheet only as a file export; the fixture answers the Sheets values API as n8n's node calls it

reads.note: Sheets v4 values.get of the default range A:F with valueRenderOption=UNFORMATTED_VALUE (n8n's Google Sheets v1 read, service account); the first row is the key row, a sheet with no cells has no values key

branches: no rows: Read Sheet outputs nothing and the run stops
expect.offline: Spreadsheet File v1 writes the rows as XLS (SheetJS) inside n8n; the Dropbox upload carries those bytes, so the comparison is the upload's path and content. The service account's token request is answered by the bench (oauth2.googleapis.com).
